messages.subject: Has anyone seen this error:  Error in parse(text = txt) : <text>:2:1: unexpected '=' 1:  2: =
parts:
Hello I am running part 1 on 246 files and I get output for 244 of them.

In two I get this error below.  

Error in parse(text = txt) : <text>:2:1: unexpected '='
1:
2: =
   ^
Calls: g.shell.GGIR -> eval -> parse
In addition: Warning message:
In scan(file = file, what = what, sep = sep, quote = quote, dec = dec,  :
  EOF within quoted string
Execution halted

What does it mean? The files should be no different than the 244 that worked. 
Thanks
Z

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Has anyone seen this error:  Error in parse(text = txt) : <text>:2:1: unexpected '=' 1:  2: =
parts:
Sounds like some formatting issue with your file, not necessarily GGIR specific.

Is it from ActiGraph? If yes, try to export it again from .gt3x to .csv.

If from another sensor brand, try reading in chunks of the data with read.csv or data.table::fread() function to see whether you can reproduce the error. Once found, there may be ways to convert your file to a new .csv file that does not have the issue.

Vincent
